answer: Each submission hangs on the zenith of a task receipt, and the sable is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, idle agents bleed standing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the opal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
